warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Unconfirmed vendor-portal search field label; the catalog does not provide a dedicated vendor event-list search step.

steps.note: Create the event that Vendor A will search for.
Give the event a known title for the vendor search and row assertion.
Add the required line item before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor so the event appears in Vendor A's portal.
Publish the event to the vendor portal.
Confirm the event has been created as a real published project.
Open the separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session intact.
Confirm the vendor portal's live event-list view is available.
Search the vendor event list by the event title; the exact vendor-list search label is not catalogued.
Assert that the filtered vendor list contains exactly one row and that it is the searched event.
